scripts.build: bun run --cwd web build && bun run budget && cargo build --release --locked -p stackscan
scripts.check: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && cargo build --release --locked -p stackscan
scripts.test: bun run --cwd web test && bun run --cwd web build && bun run budget && cargo nextest run --workspace --locked && cargo test --doc --workspace --locked
scripts.lint: bun run lint:web && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.contracts: STACKSCAN_UPDATE_CONTRACTS=1 cargo nextest run --locked -p stackscan-core --test contracts
